info.title: Event Planner API
info.description: A RESTful API built with Express and MongoDB to seamlessly manage tech events, conferences, and venue locations.

get.description: Retrieves an array containing all events currently stored in the database.

200.description: A list of events successfully retrieved.

500.description: Internal Server Error. Failed to connect to the database or execute the query.

post.description: Creates a new event records. Input data is passed through the validation middleware before insertion.

400.description: Bad Request. Provided fields failed data validation constraints.

500.description: Internal Server Error. Database operation unacknowledged.

get.description: Retrieves the detailed profile of a single event matching the provided MongoDB ObjectId.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Valid 24-character hex string representing the MongoDB ObjectId.

404.description: Not Found. No event matches the provided ID.

put.description: Completely replaces an existing event's attributes using the specified ID. Data validation applies.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique ID of the event to modify.

204.description: Event updated successfully. No content returned.

400.description: Bad Request. Invalid ID format or malformed request body.

404.description: Not Found. Target event does not exist or no modifications were performed.

delete.description: Permanently removes an event from the collection based on its ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique ID of the event to delete.

204.description: Event deleted successfully. No content returned.

404.description: Not Found. Event record not found in the database.

get.description: Retrieves an array containing all location/venue records from the database.

200.description: A list of locations successfully retrieved.

post.description: Registers a new physical or logistical location. Subject to data validation checks.

400.description: Bad Request. Required fields missing or formatted incorrectly.

get.description: Retrieves specific venue details using its corresponding MongoDB ObjectId.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Valid 24-character hex string representing the venue ID.

404.description: Not Found. No venue matched the provided ID.

put.description: Updates the properties of an existing location via its ID, ensuring validation parameters are passed.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique ID of the location to update.

204.description: Location properties updated successfully. No content returned.

400.description: Bad Request. Malformed body schema or incorrect ID structure.

404.description: Not Found. Location record could not be found.

delete.description: Removes a venue/location record from the database by its ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique ID of the location to delete.

204.description: Location successfully removed from the system.

404.description: Not Found. Location could not be mapped to an existing record.

description.example: An annual gathering of tech enthusiasts, developers, and entrepreneurs focusing on AI trends and cloud architectures.
